scope: Finite supplied-excerpt evidence qualification and matched typed zero-shot reader engineering; no benchmark claim.

wrapper.contract_sha256: SHA256 of these exact contract file bytes

raw_case.query: Verbatim hypothesis; no separately annotated retrieval hints.
raw_case.identifiers: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,95}; unique case IDs and source IDs within case.
raw_case.annotations: Gold, spans, units, references, graphs, expected decisions and derived evidence fields rejected.

segmentation: One entire provided source text is one indivisible evidence unit. Exact character [0,len(text)] and UTF8 byte spans; no paragraph or sentence parser.

retrieval.BGE_query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
retrieval.native: Exact @ruvector/core0.1.33/platform0.1.31/core2.3.0 actual insert/search; observed order preserved, no rerank or Python vector ranking.
retrieval.lexical: Casefolded Unicode word-set Jaccard, source-index tie break.
retrieval.isolation: Every native index contains only supplied sources for that case.

packing.context: Exact selected source.text with no added evidence, reformatting or truncation.
packing.budget_scope: Actual complete rendered model prompt tokens, including context and hypothesis, validated before each forward. Overbudget fails the attempt without a forward.
packing.forwards: Exactly six cases x three arms =18 sequential batch-size-one pairs; shared one reader and fixed prompt.

numeric_provenance.extraction: Source-only exact number/year-candidate, currency, scale, percent and finite period lexemes with exact char and UTF8 offsets. No amount arithmetic, conversions, broad numeric parser or legal inference.
numeric_provenance.year_candidate: A four-digit numeric lexeme in [1000,2999], explicitly lexical candidate only.
numeric_provenance.absence: Missing evidence, retrieval miss, absent number/year or absent marker never independently yields global insufficiency or legal insufficiency.
numeric_provenance.guard_scope: Selected source only; source guard decision always null. Main reader decision null on structural unknown. Separate author-owned guards never call NLI.

reader_output.probabilities: Uncalibrated conditional valid-label/code softmax from one fixed causal forward, not native NLI probabilities.

initialization_gate: All BGE/tokenizer/native/Qwen initialization only after worker validates frozen plan, actual remote admission, exact owner lease and all source/runtime pins.
retention: One worker reservation, no retry. Fsync progress before/after model initialization and each forward; raw failure and partial counts retained.
